privileged_info_for_vlm: The PEBL language uses .pbl extensions. A valid script must include a Start() function. Treisman & Gelade (1980) refers to Feature vs Conjunction search; the script should define set sizes (typically 1, 5, 15 or 4, 8, 12, 30) and target presence/absence. The command 'run-pebl' is the standard way to launch these tasks in the environment.
